intro: Aira Coffee Table celebrates contrast done right—cool marble balanced by warm wood. Light in appearance yet solid in build, it creates a centrepiece that feels refined, grounded, and enduring.

features.title: Banswara marble top for lasting durability
features.text: The Aira tabletop is crafted from natural Banswara white marble, prized for its strength, fine grain, and long-lasting performance. An added acrylic coating enhances surface protection while preserving the marble’s natural sheen and elegance.

features.title: Spacious rounded tabletop
features.text: A generously proportioned, rounded tabletop offers ample surface area for everyday use. The smooth curves create a welcoming form while allowing easy movement around the table.

features.title: Robust and stable support structure
features.text: The understructure is built from solid Sheesham wood, providing a strong, well-balanced foundation. Its inherent density ensures excellent stability, keeping the table sturdy and dependable in daily use.

features.title: Aesthetic contrast of wood and marble
features.text: The combination of cool white marble and warm Sheesham wood creates a visually striking contrast. This interplay of textures and tones in the table adds depth, sophistication, and timeless appeal to your living space.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
